claims.claim: Automatic Plastic Bottle Making Machine used to make PET plastic bottles
claims.evidence: Witness identifies it as an industrial sealing machine with a likely sealing or pressing unit; Photo 0 shows 'JENASE INDUSTRIES' and internal sealing components, not a bottle-making line.
Photos do not show the machine powered on or operating.
No service records, dealer stamp, or receipt visible in the photos.
Photos show internal components but cannot confirm dies, molds, change parts, or accessories are present.
Photo shows 'JENASE INDUSTRIES' text but no manufacturer certificate or nameplate proving original origin.

risks.risk: Machine does not power on or operate.
risks.proof: Video of the machine powering up and completing a sealing cycle.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-working, for spares or scrap only.

risks.risk: Heating or sealing element is worn or damaged.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the sealing element plus a test seal on plastic film.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing element repair or replacement.

risks.risk: Dies, molds, or change parts are missing.
risks.proof: Photo showing all tooling, dies, and change parts included with the machine.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as base machine without tooling.

risks.risk: Voltage or power requirements are incompatible with Abuja supply.
risks.proof: Photo of the nameplate showing voltage, phase, and power rating.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with the risk of needing a transformer or rewiring.

risks.risk: Motor, electronics, or sensors are faulty.
risks.proof: Video of the machine running under load with all functions tested.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working until tested.

risks.risk: Age and usage history are unknown; high hours or heavy wear.
risks.proof: Nameplate photo with manufacture date and an hour-meter reading or service log.

risks.risk: Manuals, tools, and accessories are not included.
risks.proof: Photo of all manuals, tools, and accessories laid out with the machine.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and performing a seal cycle.
Close-up photo of the nameplate showing voltage, model, serial, and manufacture date.
Photo of all dies, molds, change parts, manuals, tools, and accessories included.
Service records or dealer invoice confirming recent service.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as an industrial sealing machine, so it can be valued at its worst case even though the seller's bottle-making claim is contradicted and condition is unproven.
